title: Count Target Pairs
prompt:
**Tình huống.** Given n ≤ 200000 integers a[i] and a target x, count the pairs i < j with a[i] + a[j] = x.

**Thuật toán nào phù hợp nhất? Chương trình chỉ cần in ra chữ cái.**

**A)** Nested loops over all pairs

**B)** Sort, then two pointers from both ends

**C)** Segment tree with lazy propagation

**D)** Binary search on the answer

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: n^2 pairs is 4·10^10 — too slow. After sorting, the two-pointer sweep counts pairs in O(n log n).
